tasks.task:
# Dispatch T1 — storage-level snapshot recovery (engineer)

Feature snapshot-recovery, revision r30, approved plan. Scope: ONLY the four T1 files below. Implement to the reviewed specification; do not research external APIs, do not edit other files, no network.

## Files (your only write set)
- internal/storage/recovery.go (new)
- internal/storage/recovery_test.go (new)
- internal/storage/store.go (edit)
- internal/storage/store_edge_test.go (edit)

## Read first
- .scratch/snapshot-recovery/spec.md — sections R1, R2, R5, R6, D1–D12, AC1-1..AC1-4, AC1-7 and the §6.1 envelope; read the current internal/storage/store.go, snapshot_v1.go, internal/config/config.go, internal/observe/log.go.
- AC1-1..AC1-4, AC1-7 are yours to make pass, end to end.

## Required behavior (from spec; spec text wins on conflict)
- New startup recovery entry point in internal/storage that, per family (snapshot, prompts), stats the configured path behind a test seam: absent (incl. dangling symlink) => zero recoveries, no mutation; directory or other non-regular mode => typed fatal ErrSnapshotUnrecoverable (never open/read/rename); rejected regular file => quarantine exactly once by os.Rename into the same state dir, preserving bytes.
- Quarantine naming/reservation: <family>.corrupt-<RFC3339Nano UTC Z>.json; reserve each candidate with O_CREATE|O_EXCL first; fs.ErrExist advances the candidate (not fatal); any other create error, rename failure, or exhaustion of 4096 candidates is fatal; only a successful reservation is renamed over (never overwrite).
- Reason taxonomy per seeded class and family exactly as spec (corrupt_json, checksum_mismatch, unsupported_schema, validation_failure, read_error via injected read seam; schema-1 decoding failures map to corrupt_json; prompts checksum sentinel behavior preserved).
- Retention per family only, after a run that created a quarantine file: keep this run's file unconditionally plus newest pre-existing up to QuarantineKeep (5) total; tie-break and pinned/over-protection rules, foreign-family and cross-family names untouched, symlink-target/alias protection per spec.
- Run-level pre-pass: protected-set population and orphaned link / mutual-loop reconciliation per D11/D12 (component-wise chain resolution, original-configured-path + pre-move entry identity keying); do not include recovery inside ensureReplaceable; retention only when a file was created.
- No retention pass in the zero-recovery path.

## Tests (RED/GREEN, deterministic)
Add focused tests in recovery_test.go and extend store_edge_test.go covering AC1-1 (a-d), AC1-2 classes for both families, AC1-3 retention bound/tie-break/foreign/protection, AC1-4 prompts-only, and AC1-7 no-mutation/no-retention-when-no-creation. Fixed clock seam, fresh temp dirs, no chmod/root dependencies, no sleeps. Keep existing tests passing.

## Verify (report exact commands+outputs)
1. go build ./...
2. go test ./internal/storage/ -run 'TestRecover' -count=1
3. go test ./internal/storage/ -count=1
Any failing pre-existing test must be reported, not hidden. End with INCOMPLETE if any AC is unimplemented.
